title: Negotiating deadline, scope, quality and technical debt

videos.script: Product wants scheduled deliveries live on the first of December. The team's estimate is ten weeks. The calendar has eight. {{title}} There are four things to trade: scope, time, people and quality. Three of them have a cost anybody can see. The fourth only looks like a lever, and moving it is borrowing in secret. {{levers}} So this lesson starts where lesson nine did: what each side needs, not what each side asks for. The date that matters turns out to be one client's campaign. {{interests}} Then the feature, cut into slices that work on their own. Seven weeks of it ship in December. The rest has a date in January. {{slices}} Then technical debt, priced in the other side's unit. And finally the note that turns every new request into a visible trade.
